title: Left-hand composition normalization
statement:
For every scheme morphism h, open W and complex I, normalize the LEFT-hand composition-localization expression to the quotient of the underived complex composition map b0 followed by the open direct-image localization unit and the open derived direct image of the three-map chain consisting of the restricted-direct-image unit, inverse exact X-restriction factor and inverse derived restriction comparison. There is no image component and no exact Y-restriction factor in this conclusion. Definitions: [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data], [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-data], [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-restriction-localization-chain]. Exact Lean statement:
theorem schemeMV_composition_left_normalization
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : Y.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    let F := (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage h.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)
    let R := schemeDerivedDirectImage W.ι
    (schemeMVDirectImageLocalization h).app (schemeOpenModuleImageComplex X (h ⁻¹ᵁ W) I) ≫
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage h).map (schemeMVOpenImageLocalization X (h ⁻¹ᵁ W) I) ≫
      (schemeMVOpenComparison h W (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)).hom =
    (let LX := schemeOpenRestriction X (h ⁻¹ᵁ W)
     let J := (LX.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I
     let G := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (h ∣_ W).toLRSHom.toShHom
     let RY := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage W.ι.toLRSHom.toShHom
     let b₀ := (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso
         (schemeMVUnderivedOpenComposition h W) (.up ℤ) ≪≫
       (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso (Iso.refl (G ⋙ RY)) (.up ℤ)).symm).hom.app J
     DerivedCategory.Q.map b₀ ≫
       (schemeMVDirectImageLocalization W.ι).app
         ((G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J) ≫
       R.map ((schemeMVDirectImageLocalization (h ∣_ W)).app J ≫
         (schemeDerivedDirectImage (h ∣_ W)).map
           (LX.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app I) ≫
         (schemeMVOpenRestrictionComparison h W).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)))

proof.text: Put J equal to the termwise restriction of I. Apply schemeMVOpenComposition_complex_localization to J and the canonical composition isomorphism beta. Its unit square gives the equation before exact restriction factors. Naturality of beta along the inverse exact X-restriction factor moves this factor to the restricted direct image on the right. Expand open-image localization and the canonical open comparison; postcompose with open direct image of the inverse derived restriction comparison. Associativity and functoriality combine the final three factors. No image isomorphism, Y exact restriction factor, K-injectivity or cover hypothesis is used.
